ChartConstruction.description:
Chart construction type. CANDLES is the safe default (real OHLC).
RENKO is opt-in for grid/scaling strategies and requires brick_size_atr in entry_params.
HEIKIN_ASHI is rejected — synthetic price means backtests don't validate real edge.
ChartConstruction.title: ChartConstruction

ProfitScalingTier.description:
Profit-tier sizing config (W5a / Tier 5.4).

Pairs with `compute_profit_tier()` and `compute_position_sizes()` in
`src/engine/sizing.py`. Every `threshold` of cumulative single-account profit
adds `increment` extra micro contracts to the base ATR-derived size, capped by
the firm-specific cap and the global CONTRACT_CAP_MAX (20).

DSL fixtures emit `{"increment": 2, "threshold": 3000}` only —
`account_pnl_total` is injected at backtest-run time from live account PnL,
so it is intentionally absent from the schema.
ProfitScalingTier.title: ProfitScalingTier

description: Strategy Definition Language — the strict schema every strategy must conform to.

bypass_news_blackout.description: When True, strategy explicitly opts into trading during news windows. Required for event-driven strategies like news_fade_mcl. Must be explicitly set — no default opt-in.
bypass_news_blackout.title: Bypass News Blackout

chart_construction.description: Chart bar construction. 'candles' (default) uses real OHLC. 'renko' is opt-in for grid/scaling strategies — requires brick_size_atr in entry_params.

daily_target_dollars.description: Daily P&L target in dollars (informational). None = no target.
daily_target_dollars.title: Daily Target Dollars

entry_condition.description: Plain English entry rule, one sentence
entry_condition.title: Entry Condition

frankenstein_test_mode.description: Shuffle mode for A4 Frankenstein randomization test. None = full_shuffle.
frankenstein_test_mode.title: Frankenstein Test Mode

profit_scaling_tier.description: Optional profit-tier sizing config. When None, no scaling.

sizing_method.description: Position sizing method. None = existing fixed/ATR logic (backward-compatible). 'kelly' = Kelly Criterion optimal sizing (quarter-Kelly by default). 'fixed' = fixed contracts (same as None, explicit). 'atr_based' = dynamic ATR sizing (same as None, explicit).
sizing_method.title: Sizing Method

bias_timeframe.description: W23G.11 / W23H.1 — Higher timeframe used for trend bias (e.g. '4h', '1h', '1d'). REQUIRED for any strategy whose source describes ANY specific HTF reference for entry logic (e.g. JackTrades 4H+15M+1M, ICT/Power-of-3/CRT workflows). Emit null ONLY for truly single-timeframe strategies with zero HTF references.
bias_timeframe.title: Bias Timeframe

bias_condition.description: W23G.11 / W23H.1 — Plain-English summary of the HTF rule (e.g. 'ema_50_4h > ema_200_4h', '4H candle range defined', 'price > prior_4H_high'). REQUIRED when bias_timeframe is non-null.
bias_condition.title: Bias Condition

execution_timeframe.description: W23H.1 — Lower timeframe for actual entry signals (typically equals 'timeframe' field). Emit when strategy uses MTF — e.g. JackTrades 4H bias + 15M execution.
execution_timeframe.title: Execution Timeframe

primary_indicator.description: W23G.11 — For confluence strategies, alias of entry_indicator (the main trigger). May equal entry_indicator; null for single-indicator strategies.
primary_indicator.title: Primary Indicator

params.description: Indicator parameters (e.g. {period:14}) — use {} when no params

direction.description: Must this confirmation agree (same direction), disagree (opposite), or either with primary?

confirming_indicators.description: W23G.11 / W23H.D — For multi-step/confluence strategies (ICT/SMC/Wyckoff/CRT, ORB+VWAP, EMA-cross+RSI, etc.) list each subsidiary structural mechanic or indicator confirmation. Each item is {indicator, params, direction}. REQUIRED when source describes ≥2 entry conditions OR for any archetype:* strategy with subsidiary mechanics. Emit null ONLY for truly single-step single-condition strategies (rare in practice).
confirming_indicators.title: Confirming Indicators

min_factors_satisfied.description: W23H.D — How many of (1 primary + N confirming) must fire before entry. REQUIRED when confirming_indicators is non-empty. Defaults: 2 for 2 confirming, 3 for 3+ confirming.
min_factors_satisfied.title: Min Factors Satisfied

preferred_regimes.description: W23H.B — Regimes in which the strategy is allowed to fire. Multi-valued array. Decision tree: for archetype:* (ICT/SMC/Wyckoff/CRT/FVG/order_block/silver_bullet/turtle_soup/power_of_3/ote/breaker) default to ALL 3 ['TRENDING_UP','TRENDING_DOWN','RANGE_BOUND'] unless source explicitly narrows. For mean-reversion → ['RANGE_BOUND']. For trend-following/breakout → ['TRENDING_UP','TRENDING_DOWN']. REQUIRED — emit null only when truly undetermined.
preferred_regimes.title: Preferred Regimes

confluence_factors.description: W23F.B — Subset of canonical 5 confluence factors the source explicitly references. Emit only tokens source explicitly mentions; null or empty if none referenced.
confluence_factors.title: Confluence Factors

source_claim_win_rate.description: W23F.B — When source EXPLICITLY states a win rate %, emit as float 0-1 (e.g. 0.65 for 65%). Emit null if not stated. NEVER fabricate.
source_claim_win_rate.title: Source Claim Win Rate

source_claim_avg_r.description: W23F.B — When source EXPLICITLY states avg R, emit float (e.g. 2.1 for 2.1R avg). Emit null if not stated. NEVER fabricate.
source_claim_avg_r.title: Source Claim Avg R
